reasoning: 1. TARGET ENGAGEMENT: Strong evidence of target engagement - rituximab achieved therapeutic plasma concentrations (228-299 µg/mL) and demonstrated progressive CD19+ lymphocyte depletion from 50.5% to 87.5% over treatment cycles, confirming CD20 targeting and B-cell depletion. 2. PATHWAY MODULATION: The downstream biology moved as expected - progressive B-cell depletion occurred with increasing rituximab exposure, demonstrating the CD20-mediated mechanism was functioning. 3. CLINICAL TRANSLATION: The primary endpoint was met successfully - only 1.1% of patients developed Grade 3-4 infusion reactions with the accelerated infusion schedule, demonstrating the safety objective was achieved. 4. POPULATION EFFECTS: No subgroup analysis reported, but the overall population responded appropriately to the intervention. 5. CONFOUNDERS: This was a safety/tolerability study with an appropriate design to assess infusion-related reactions with faster administration.
